title: Remainder of encoded natural numbers
statement: For natural numbers $a$ and $b$, let their binary expansions be paired by doubling each bit of the expansion of $a$, appending the separator $01$, and then appending the expansion of $b$. Applying the operation that decodes the pair, reads the two binary values, and returns the binary expansion of their remainder yields the binary expansion of $a \bmod b$.
